posts.title: WOYWW
posts.description: Good morning all This morning I am sharing a little video sweep across my table - hoping it works. These are the cards that I made with my linen scraplets. I think I might be gifting a few of them as they will be useful I'm sure. Below is a little tree dec that I made with a wooden curtain ring. I had some very chunky chenille yarn so I crocheted round the ring then added a few stitches and beads. I don't think it will be a money maker as it was a bit fiddly but it will look nice on my tree . I also knitted some Ferrero Richer covers. These are Christmas puds but I was waiting for my green yarn to arrive for the leaves. Annie said she thinks I'll need bigger buns!!!! Cute! Finally, I just wanted to share with you what happened at Maxine's workshop on Saturday. It was near Stafford organized by Margaret, one of Maxine's frequent attendees. Sarah and Eva were both booked on this Stafford Hills landscape workshop. So, Eva, Max and Margaret shared a big hug and they set a place for Sarah.

posts.title: WOYWW
posts.description: Welcome to my WOYWW table of delights! I have been on a roll this week..... I used my linen scraplets for some gift tags. I just enjoyed adding them to some left over fabric bits along with a tiny button or two. Then I recycled some denim scraps for little brooches. I just added a few beads and some hand embroidery. This was my attempt at a gnome chocolate orange cover. I quite liked his boucle alpaca yarn beard 🤣 And, this is where I was on Monday ... Powis Castle. We had a little walk round the garden, coffee and cake and a visit to the Divali display in the museum. It was colourful with some gorgeous silk sari fabrics. I liked the Indian music in the background and even offered to do a little dancing for the gentleman guide on duty 🤣 You can't take me anywhere! These pictures are totally untouched - the sky really was that colour. That's me for this week. Have a good week all x x Jo 🌈

posts.title: WOYWW
posts.description: Good morning all! We've had a few drab, grey, foggy days this week so seeing my beautiful Winter flowering clematis really cheered me up. It is covered in these delicate, rosey pink blooms. I had a mad moment this week when I decided to sort out two little drawers full of vintage table linens. Some are just scraps left over from other projects I also tipped out a small box of lace scraps... I snipped and sorted most of a morning and arranged the tiny scraps of embroidery on some linen.... I thought they would make some lovely little cards. These are just about ready to mount... I think I shall group them into sets. They might make nice gifts. So that's me for this week. I know lots of you watched the video of Sarah's funeral but I just thought I would say what a moving service it was. Sarah was so well loved and will be so missed by all her lovely family and friends. Maxine and I managed a few words with one of her boys. All three were smart, handsome lads.
